notes: No parent company is stated on the retrievable page text, so no parent is claimed. Page note: AllStyle commenced operations in May 1990; early systems used style 1 (manual numbering), most later units style 2 (computer generated). Page style 1 is HELD, not shipped: its year is the 4th-5th characters REVERSED (page example: '29' reversed to '92' = 1992), and reversed digit slices are not expressible in the locked schema; its month letter chart is also not in retrievable text. Style 2 ships year-only in both variants: the month letter chart ('see chart below') did not surface in the text fetch (no chart image URL was returned for this page), so month is held pending a chart/image read. Style 2a table judgment call, flagged for coordinator review: the page states only that a single digit was used during the 1990s; the 0-9 to 1990-1999 table below is the mechanical reading of that bound (digit = ones digit of a 199x year), not a page-printed per-digit table.

styles.era: 1990s, single-digit year + letter + 5 digits + letter (page style 2, single-digit variant)
styles.notes: Page example 3C48549S. Year = 1st digit preceding the letter; page states a single digit was used during the 1990s, which bounds the era for this explicit digit-keyed table (see file notes for the judgment-call flag). Month = letter after the year code, chart not available in retrievable text, so year-only. Digit-keyed table is used because the locked schema's year 'digits' kind requires a 2- or 4-character slice.

Year = 1st two digits preceding the letter; page states two digits after 1999, the first being '0' prior to 2010, '1' prior to 2020, etc. Month = letter after the year code, chart not available in retrievable text, so year-only.
